the Toronto Stock Exchange has approved its normal-course issuer bid, allowing the company to repurchase and cancel up to 8.11M common shares, or about 5% of its outstanding shares.
The buyback is expected to begin September 23 and run through September 22, 2027, or until the authorized purchases are completed.
The company said the limit represents 25% of its average daily trading volume on the TSX during the six months ended August 31.
